item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Skipperlabskovs, slow-cooked beef chuck simmered with onion, potatoes and spices, served with baked beetroot with bite and topped with plenty of chopped chives. Served with pickled beetroot, whipped butter, coarse mustard and rye bread. Also available gluten free. (1+6+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Hoisin duck stir fry, pulled duck leg cooked in hoisin and Chinese rice wine, tossed with vegetables and served on jasmine rice, topped with toasted sesame seeds and spring onion. Also available gluten free. (1+7+8+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Hoisin soy protein stir fry, soy protein cooked in hoisin and Chinese rice wine, tossed with vegetables and served on jasmine rice, topped with toasted sesame seeds and spring onion. Also available gluten free. (1+7+8+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Noodles with crispy chilli, steamed pak choi and Thai fish cakes with ginger-pickled cucumber. (1+2+3+7+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Noodles with crispy chilli, steamed pak choi and spicy edamame cakes with ginger-pickled cucumber. (1+2+3+7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Tandoori chicken thighs, an Indian-Pakistani favourite. Yoghurt-marinated chicken with plenty of spices. Served with rice and mint and coriander chutney. (6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tandoori tempeh, an Indian-Pakistani favourite. Yoghurt-marinated tempeh with plenty of spices. Served with rice and mint and coriander chutney. (6+7+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Japanese-spiced pork neck chops served with okonomiyaki (Japanese cabbage pancake tossed with noodles, vegetables, pickled ginger and egg), topped with spring onion. Served with okonomiyaki sauce, kewpie mayonnaise, pickled ginger and aonori (seaweed powder). Also available gluten free. (1+2+7+8+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Japanese-spiced tofu served with okonomiyaki (Japanese cabbage pancake tossed with noodles, vegetables, pickled ginger and egg), topped with spring onion. Served with okonomiyaki sauce, kewpie mayonnaise, pickled ginger and aonori (seaweed powder). Also available gluten free and vegan. (1+2+7+8+11+15)
